extracted.intended_audience: writers, comedians, and creators interested in using AI to write jokes
extracted.subtask_description: Using AI language models (augmented with explicit structure and professional joke-writing techniques) to produce good, original jokes. Focus is on how to prompt or architect an AI system to generate humor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Good, original jokes
rubrics_metrics.description: By themselves, AI language models can’t write good, original jokes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page highlights 'good, original' as the target quality for jokes; success should be evaluated on both funniness/quality and originality (not merely parroting existing jokes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide explicit joke structure to the AI
rubrics_metrics.description: An AI system can write jokes if it’s explicitly told how to structure a joke.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied guidance: prompts or systems should encode clear joke-structure instructions (set-up, punchline, misdirection, rule-of-three, etc.) so the model follows a comedic blueprint rather than generating free-form text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporate professional joke-writing techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: Combine a large language model with professional joke-writing techniques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page promotes a hybrid approach (Witscript) that pairs LLM capabilities with craft techniques; evaluate solutions on whether they integrate recognized joke-writing methods from professional practitioners.
